claim: Per-agent conditional coverage of conformal prediction intervals is well-concentrated around the nominal level across agents.
falsifier: Apply conformal prediction to multiple agents in a similar setting and measure the distribution of per-agent conditional coverage.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported multi-agent system, 50 agents, hourly signals, and 80% nominal level; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Agent-level conditional coverage estimation–coverage concentration…

claim: Adding a synthetic SFT stage before GRPO alignment increases the performance gains from alignment relative to skipping SFT, for both process-based and solution-based rewards.
falsifier: Compare GRPO alignment with and without a preceding synthetic SFT stage under identical reward designs; the SFT-first pipeline should show larger average gains over zero-shot performance.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported models, synthetic tasks, reward designs, and evaluation settings; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Presence of a synthetic for performance increase from alignment

claim: Introducing a physics-based surrogate that is learned from data during training enables reinforcement learning algorithms to reliably converge for difficult high-dimensional accelerator control environments, bypassing the need to build differentiable environments.
falsifier: One could implement an RL agent for a high-dimensional control task where a physics-based surrogate is learned online from environment interactions, and compare convergence rates and final performance against a model-free baseline and against a version using a pre-built differentiable environment.

conditions: surrogate is learned from data during agent training
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported accelerator control tasks (single cryomodule and CEBAF north linac) and the specific RL framework with actor-critic and learnable constraints; transfer to other systems or tasks is unestablished.

title: Using a physics-based surrogate for reliable convergence and avoidance
